Directed with humor, grace and impact by Rivendell Artistic Director Tara Mallen, the 90-minute drama running through April 6 offers an understated but rich snapshot of the transcendent triumphs and terrifying trials that come with surviving more than seven decades.
WIPEOUT gifts audiences a hilarious exploration of aging, friendship, and womanhood that's as fun as a day at the beach and as bittersweet as a setting sun.
Rivendell’s new season, collectively entitled “It’s Women’s Work,” opens with a terrific World Premiere production.
Mirthful and snappy quips and zingers make up the bulk of the women’s conversations and keep the show afloat.

During this fast paced 90 minutes of theater, written by Aurora Real de Asua and sharply directed by Tara Mallen, we learn a great deal about each of these ladies and their relationship, both in the past and now.

cn.t: Critics praise "Wipeout" for its rare and spirited portrayal of three women in their 70s taking surfing lessons, with reviewers celebrating the production's refreshing focus on older female friendship and adventure.
